$comment: Who may do what, where. Validated against @custodes/schema Policy at startup. Every change is a reviewed PR. Signing keys are generated by the broker's Keyring; the only per-agent secret is the PAT.

pr-gate.$comment: ADR 0011: closes community PRs that break CONTRIBUTING.md, with a signed comment. hotl; the agent also caps itself at 10 closes per UTC day.
pr-gate.$comment_isolated: ADR 0018: moved to custodes-pr-gate (cutover); the shared entrypoint refuses it.

cheatsheet-review.$comment: ADR 0017: multi-model review of a pull request when the operator adds the trigger label; posts one review with inline suggestions (never APPROVE) and removes the label. hotl because every run is started by the operator (the agent re-checks who added the label in the timeline). OWASP added 2026-10-30 after the evals and the sandbox end-to-end runs passed; every OWASP review is posted only after the operator approves it (requiresApprovalOn).
cheatsheet-review.$comment_requiresApprovalOn: ADR 0017 amendment: on OWASP a review is posted only after the operator approves it through the e-mailed link. The sandbox posts directly, for quick end-to-end runs.

triage-apply.$comment: ADR 0019 (#108): applies one triage proposal per issue (assign, labels, comment) only after the operator approves the bundle through the e-mailed link. hitl: every action needs that approval. Own Worker and key (ADR 0018). Comments carry only the hidden trailer (operator decision, #108). Approvals live 7 days, 50 pending at most: the digest is daily and read in batches.
triage-apply.$comment_repos: Sandbox first (ADR 0007, ADR 0012); OWASP/CheatSheetSeries added 2026-11-13 after the evals (44/44, #106) and the sandbox end-to-end run passed (#108 comment). Still hitl: every bundle waits for the operator's approval.
triage-apply.$comment_labels: The OWASP labels from #108 except the automation triggers (AUTOMATION_TRIGGER_LABELS in packages/schema): custodes_cheatsheet_review starts a cheatsheet-review run and jules starts Google Jules, which pushes a branch and opens a PR as the operator. This PAT is the operator's account, so its label would count as the operator's trigger (ADR 0019; security review of #113).

triage.$comment_isolated: ADR 0018: moved to custodes-triage on 2026-11-12 with implementation-check and proposal-review; the shared entrypoint refuses them.

triage-apply.$comment: ADR 0019: the issue and its comments, to check a proposal against the thread before asking for an approval (the broker reads them again before running it).
